text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy is a late bloomer compared 
to other Umamusume. Deeming the Satsuki 
Sho too great a burden for her current 
self, she decided to pass on it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: conquering the Japan Derby. The 
grand stage that captivated her as a 
child. However, entering it without graded 
race experience would be unrealistic.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
They try to make the Aoba Sho—held at the 
same racecourse and distance—their prep 
race, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume has ever won both the Aoba 
Sho and the Nippon Derby. That is 
precisely why doing so would be a hero's 
medal.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is decided: the Aoba Sho. 
Setting her path along the royal road, she 
turns yet another page.
